steps.text: On the endless barrens, a red-haired Vulpo man squats on the ground, concentrating hard on something.
Not far behind him is a car, undergoing inspection from a Lupo with white hair and a Feline in black.
The three of them seem like companions, and their ride, broken down.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, Aosta, come over here.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Look at these bugs.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: See what they're doing? All walking in a line.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: And their group's pretty long too. Let me see where they're heading.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Looks like you're charged back up.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yeah, I'm feeling a lot better now!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I don't put too much stock in your own self-reports, though.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What are you, my mamma?!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You were coughing blood half an hour ago.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha ha, but I'm not now.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ah, shit. I spent too long talking to you and now the bugs are gone.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Forget it. I'm going back to fix the car again.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, have you guys figured out what's wrong with the car yet? Want me to come help?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: The tubing's busted in places. The engine won't start.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Me and Broca can deal with it. Just stay in one place, okay.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Not like I've got anywhere to go. There's nothing out here, and nowhere to run to.
Following a rumble, the engine comes to life again.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Phew... Broca, go and call Chiave back here.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yo, Broca, why don't we see who can piss farther!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: My bladder is empty.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You don't give him straight answers to these, Broca.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Damn, that's a shame! This is perfect weather to piss to!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Aside from polar wastes, I don't think there's any weather bad for p... for relieving yourself.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You just don't get it, Aosta. It's all about a feeling!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ah, a perfect arc—che cazzo!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: The wind just blew my perfect arc onto my shoes! Tch, what a bummer.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Just leave it, we're gonna go. If we can't find a rendezvous before sundown, we'll have to sleep out on the barrens tonight.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What's wrong with the barrens?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Look at it this way, I've never been camping before! Let's camp out today!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: The barrens are a death trap, and realistically speaking, this jacked ride doesn't even have any camping equipment in it. Our only place to sleep is inside.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Also, fuel is another problem.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Cheh. The last owner just didn't get it.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I don't think the average city car owner would have any camping stuff prepared, let alone additional fuel.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Who knows if one day someone'll borrow your car to go camping, eh? It doesn't hurt to prepare!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: And would you?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Eh... no.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Then shut up and get ready to leave.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Aight.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Are we off now?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Mm-hm. Let me drive.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Whaaat? Isn't it my turn?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You just relax.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Aosta, you know something? You get more and more like a mamma every day.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, Broca, you get where I'm coming from?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: A little.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: It's because both of you have Oripathy.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I hear good life habits help keep illness in check. You should go to bed earlier every day, Chiave.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: God, y'know, Aosta? My own mamma never told me that.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Sticazzi... just shut up.
Aosta says as he starts the engine.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What's some good tunes to put on...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: *Clicks tongue* Respect to the owner, they listened to a lot... Ah-ha, I like the look of this sleeve. Put this on!
Chiave inserts his newfound record disc into the car's hi-fi system, and lively music bursts from the speakers—
'♪Saturday's coming, wanna ride my beast far'
'♪To your apartment with a present like a star'

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: (Whistle) Not bad.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: For sure. Okay, on we go.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: By the way, Aosta.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Mm?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Where are we heading right now?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I should've answered this before we set off.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I forgot.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I bet you weren't even listening in the first place.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I nabbed a map while were slipping out. For now, we're heading towards Locomotiva City, since it's closest.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: They've taken a rocky road with our family. As long as we're lucky, we can join up with them.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: If not, at least we have somewhere to stop over.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, I used to hear about this weird village in the west of Siracusa. It was all haunted inside. Let's go take a look.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Keep dreaming. We don't even know where it is. You don't even know if someone just made that up.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Then how about we go see a city one of the other Twelve Families runs?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, y'know, the Sicilia Legale counts as one of the Thirteen Families, but they fight each other plenty. Some alliance, hah!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: The Sicilia Legale don't organize like all the actual Families. After all, it's made up of tons of families, big and small.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Nobody from the big Families would give a shit about our Sicilia Legale nobodies.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Pff. They'll come begging for me to join them one day, no doubt about it.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: In any case, there's no heading back to Vite City for now... no, maybe we can never return.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: And we've offended the Trin Famiglia. We've got no place in Vite anymore.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha ha. We caused a shitstorm, after all. I kinda wanna see my old capo Layton. *Hack*—*spit*! See what his stupid face looks like right now.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: For sure.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha. Too late for regrets at this point.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Regrets... I wouldn't go that far. Layton was a real son of a bitch, after all.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Sold us out and still wanted us to count his money. Wasn't happening.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Mm-hm. No regrets here either.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, take your mind off it. Look, there's still some families who treat coming out of jail for the first time like an initiation, and you're not a real member until then.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: And yesterday, we defied our Family and hightailed it out of the city.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: So I now declare, you are true members of my Chiave Famiglia!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Aosta, you're the family's consigliere!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Broca, you're the family's underboss!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Heh.
'♪But when you smile at the ground it ain't hard to tell—'
'♪You don't know—'
'♪You don't know you're disgusting!'

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: By the way, we've been driving for ages without seeing a single guy, eh.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Apart from a couple gathering spots and settlements, there wouldn't be any lone travelers outside the cities in the first place.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Because there's a few families who couldn't stick it in the cities and spread out to the barrens to wreck shop. I've been with the family's caravans a few times before, and every time we'd make the right preparations.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Anyone like us, running off into the wild without a second of prep? Probably cruising down Death Road.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha, Death Road. I like that.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But yeah, back in the garage, I saw plenty of guys prepping themselves a hell of a lot of stuff to head out with.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Egh, if we coulda brought a little more to eat when we escaped, that woulda been good. Aosta—

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Forget about the food in the trunk. That's for emergencies.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I'll take the fact we escaped at all.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: If we weren't lucky enough to have Mandel on guard that night, we'd probably be tied to chairs blindfolded in a dark closet right about now.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Broca, next time something like this happens, remind me to bring more food.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You... whatever.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Man, this is boring, though. All this land forever and no way to use it.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Look, over here, we could set up a garage THIIIIIIIIS big, and then we could pimp rides inside. Wouldn't that rule?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: And what about Catastrophes? We'd have no way to stand up to one.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Egh. Catastrophes, Oripathy—nothing's ever good in this whole stretch of world.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Broca, I'm begging you, you got ANYTHING interesting?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Want to take a look?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What's this?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: A book I just finished reading.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: About what?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: A novel about a pair of lovers who were broken apart in the end due to the conflict between their two families.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: The ending is very moving.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Forget it. Whaddaya even doing bringing that kinda book?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Because Aosta said the journey would be incredibly boring.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yo, Broca, I've been pretty curious for a while now. You like reading those?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Not 'like' like. I just read them when I have nothing else to do. They're alright.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I gotcha. Yo, that reminds me, Aosta, you ever get a girlfriend before?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You, Broca?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Pfft. Me neither. I don't get what's so fun about dating.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, Aosta, I'm guessing you like that kinda book too?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I prefer political and historical titles more.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Tch, I shouldn'ta asked. Those two words make me fall asleep.
'♪She played mouth harp in a Victorian band,'
'♪But she fell in love with a Columbian man.'

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yo, can something just happen already—huh?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, Aosta, look over there.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: That's...

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: I'm begging you, my mother's growing old and my children need me...

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Outta my face. I'm feeding my old and my young just the same.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Now be nice and shut up. You piss me off and I'll open you a few new breathing holes!

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: *whimper*...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, Aosta, Broca, I've got an idea.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Don't tell me you wanna play robbers with them.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Eh? I'm saying we scare the robbers the hell outta here, and then we ask these merchant guys for some supplies. How about it?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yo, but your idea's not bad either.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: No. Actually, let's go with your plan.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: For sure?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: For sure.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: And if they don't cough up the goods, we just have to make them.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I like it! C'mon, full speed ahead, let's knock those morons into next week! Broca, get ready to fight!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Bandit A
steps.text: Hey, look over there!

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha! Get down!

steps.name: Bandit B
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: (Whisper) I'll give you an opportunity. You take it...

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: (Whisper) Got it, got it.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Also, Broca, you...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Alright. I'll do my best.

steps.name: Bandit A
steps.text: What're you mumbling about over there!?

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Out!

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Tch. You're a pretty tough guy. All of you, over here! Deal with him!

steps.name: Bandit C
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: Bandit B
steps.text: Hey, pretty boy, where you going!?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: Right, right!
With Aosta acting as bait, the bandits have momentarily overlooked the merchants' presence, and on Aosta's signal to seize this chance, they jump aboard the car.
After that, following a fit of rumbling, the car vanishes into the dirt and dust.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Cazzo, you three sons of bitches!!!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Wait, what about our supplies now?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Just stay alive!
As the merchants draw the bandits' attention, Aosta jumps aboard the gang's own ride and revs the engine up.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Chiave, get on!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yeah!
Without waiting for Chiave's response, Aosta first drives the car straight into the throng of bandits.
But Chiave's known how things roll for forever now, and after dodging two guys, he grabs onto the door handle while the ride's still accelerating, and clambers aboard.

steps.name: Bandit A
steps.text: You're not getting away!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Broca!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Here!
Broca brandishes a drill bit out of nowhere at the bandits to push them off, and the moment the car passes him, Aosta putting pedal to the metal, he turns and jumps inside.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Hold on tight!

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Tch! Don't let 'em get away!
The bandits attempt to stop the three's car, but stopping a vehicle that's already going ain't easy. Their ride breaks out of the bandits' encirclement without a hitch, and races towards the horizon.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: What are you doing staring at them?! You, you, and you, pursue the merchants! The rest of you, after those three assholes!

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: They WILL die in this wasteland today, you hear me!?

steps.name: Bandits
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Whoaaaa, Aosta, look, they're catching up to us!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I know! Fasten your seatbelts, I'm shifting this thing up!
'♪Con las manos arriba, cintura sola'
'♪Da media vuelta y sacude duro'
'♪No te quites ahora, que esto solo empieza'
Even as Aosta takes it to the redline, the bandits bite ever closer at their heels.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: These jokers just don't give up, ha—*cough* *cough*.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Chiave, don't stick your head out at them. Close the window.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What—did—you—say? I can't hear you over the wind!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Broca, pull him back in.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *hack* *cough*—What the hell are you doing?!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Aosta told you not to stick your head out.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Chiave, what's wrong? What's the coughing for?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I don't know. Probably caught too much wind in my mouth?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Hopefully that's it.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I have good news and bad news. Which do you wanna hear?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Bad news first.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: We're almost out of fuel.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha. What's the good news, then?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: The good news is, it looks like we can shake them off before we run empty.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Whoa, I can see the wall of a nomadic city from here!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Yep, that should be Locomotiva City now.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yo, doesn't look half bad. It's got more style than old Vite—*cough* *cough*.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Seriously, Chiave, are you okay?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I'm okay, I'm okay.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Then you're gonna help push the car with us. It looks real close, but if that's where we're going, we're not gonna make it today.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: The car's out of fuel, c'mon. What are we still doing with it? It's gonna be faster just to walk.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: There's actually still just a little fuel left. I'm leaving it for either when we get close, or when they catch up to us.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Also, this is the most valuable thing we have right now. Are you seriously gonna go into a city with empty pockets and try to make a living?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: (Whistle) Fine.
Even as his face says he couldn't care less, Chiave still wanders over to one corner of the car, and starts pushing it with the other two.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, Aosta, I can turn the stereo on for some tunes, right? Not like it'll waste much fuel.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: ...You can have that.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Awwrighty, ha, lemme see—let's put this one on now!
'♪Hello, brightness, my old friend'
'♪I've come to talk with you again'

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: —Tch, this song doesn't get me pumped at all.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I think it's pretty nice to listen to.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Same here.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Fine, you both like it anyway. This works.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yo, say, Aosta, you remember how we met each other, right.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Hm? Yeah.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You were still a mechanic at the time, and then you beat the shit out of my family's people. I got sent in to clean you up.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha, and then us two fought, and then we were best friends forever.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough*.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I'm fine. Broca? You still remember?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Of course. I'll never forget. You two saved me.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha ha, damn right. You really were a goddamn lunk, getting sold out by your family without even realizing.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But rest assured. I'll never deal you away.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: ...Thinking about it, we really have known each other for a while now.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Sure have—*cough* *cough*.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Chiave, I'm vetoing you. Just rest in the car, no acting strong. Me and Broca can push just fine.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hmph. I'm not acting strong.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Broca, I think we both got Oripathy together, right?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I think probably not. You just got examined at roughly the same time.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Broca's should be from that time with the fire, where someone gashed him with that Originium thing.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: And as for you, you never normally protect yourself against anything. I wouldn't be surprised no matter when you got it.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: *cough* *cough* Aosta, you spend the whole time with us, and you're gonna get it too one day.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Perhaps.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: But even if I do, something tells me it won't be that bad.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Eh? Why's that?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: It'll be better than me watching you two suffer.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha ha ha, now that's my good brother right there.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You've been talking endless crap today. Just lie down inside and relax yourself.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: *cough* *cough*.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Aosta, I've decided what's going top of the list of things I hate.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: It's Oripathy.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Broca, carry Chiave into the car.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Alright.

Broca, taciturn the whole journey through, goes over as he's told and picks Chiave up in his arms, putting him into the car's back seat, before moving right back to his original position and continuing to push the car.
As Chiave lies on the back seat, he's dazzled by the sunlight, and he brings up his arm to shield his eyes.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Heh. We got this disease, and that asshole Layton threw us out like we were disposable 'cause of it.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hated me to the point it got hard to even breathe.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Aosta, the day we become heads of the Thirteen Families, I'm gonna find some way of settling this Oripathy thing, once and for all.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Mm-hm. When the time comes, we'll get a whole taskforce of doctors just to research the disease. Or maybe those real mighty hospitals. Give them some cash and get them studying.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha, damn right. And then I'm gonna set up this whole big hospital. Gonna find every single guy the world hated 'cause of their disease, and I'm gonna throw 'em all in there and cure 'em.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: And I'll clean up every single person who hated 'em.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'll help you out.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha, of course you gotta. Aosta, you too. Don't forget, you two are my consigliere and underboss.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Mm. Chiave, you'd best stop talking now. Just rest nice and easy.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, Aosta.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What do you think about dying out here on the barrens?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: What are you talking about.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Weren't you gonna be head of the Thirteen Families? What the hell are you dying in a place like this for.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha, yeah.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But I thought about it kinda carefully just now. And nothing seems too bad about just dying here in the barrens, really.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: All the big cheeses are gonna go in the ground someday. What's the difference between death in a wasteland and death on a bed that cost a couple million, huh?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Find a couple stones, dig a hole, lie them down in it, and then close their eyes.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Pow—one person's dead.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Not so bad hearing it out loud, right.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Hold on, Chiave, what the hell are you saying?!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I'm saying, the sky today—cazzo, it's so blue—
'♪Seppellire in terra sconfinata.'
'♪O bella ciao, bella ciao, bella—'
Perhaps it was the battery that exhausted itself, as with little fanfare at all, the car stereo's music comes to a halt.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Chiave? Chiave?!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: What the hell are you dying in a place like this for?!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Broca, get in. I need to find some kind of rest stop somewhere. Hopefully I'll find someone...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Zzz... zzz...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Aosta, he just fell asleep.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Goddamn you.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: But... we still can't be hopeful about Chiave's illness. Our best option remains to find an Infected doctor who's willing to treat him...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hey, you look like you've got car problems. Do you need some help?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Here, three portions of sashimi.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha ha, about time.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: So, when you and the others got rescued by Rhodes Island, Chiave, that was when you joined them?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Not at all. That operator, codenamed Straightedge, brought us all the way to the Rhodes Island office in Locomotiva, and then asked the medical operator stationed there to give Chiave some treatment.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Eyo, Jaye, you've got some real skill.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Much appreciated. See, I always thought that was how you joined Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: How? We didn't know them from Adam yet, and besides, Aosta gave the car over in exchange for the medicine. At the time, I actually thought Rhodes Island was pretty lousy.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But Rhodes Island's medicine's pretty effective, right, Broca?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I can confirm.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: As for why we joined Rhodes Island, to put it simply, it's because Chiave offended one of the big family heads in Locomotiva, and we had people out for our blood again.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: That time, Straightedge saved us again.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: And then, under his referral, we just straight-up came to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Heh. For the record, Aosta, that one was never my fault.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: It sounds like another new story all of its own.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Heh, you got time, Jaye, brother? I'll tell it to you, in all its glory.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: It's already past midnight, and there's no missions tomorrow. I'll go get some Lungmen wine. We can drink and talk.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha, now that's a plan.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: That evening, me and Aosta were gonna go see...
The men share their stories on into the dead of night in the empty cafeteria...
